title: The flat base change map on sections: pullback of cohomology classes
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S'\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with fibre product $X'=S'\times_SX$ [def-pc-fibre-product], projections $f':X'\to S'$, $g':X'\to X$, and assume $g$ and $g'$ flat [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $\mathcal F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $\mathcal F'=g'^*\mathcal F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] and $p\ge0$. Choose injective resolutions $a:\mathcal F[0]\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ and $b:\mathcal F'[0]\to\mathcal J^\bullet$, zero in negative degrees [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Write $\mathcal F'=g'^*\mathcal F$ and choose a chain map $t:\mathcal I^\bullet\to g'_*\mathcal J^\bullet$ satisfying $ta=g'_*(b)\eta_{\mathcal F}$, with $\eta$ the pullback adjunction unit [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $A=f_*\mathcal I^\bullet$, $B=f'_*\mathcal J^\bullet$ and $q=f_*t:A\to g_*B$ (the equality $f_*g'_*=g_*f'_*$ is the sectionwise equality from the square). Define $c:g^*A\to B$ to be the termwise adjoint of $q$, and $\beta=\mathcal H^p(c):g^*R^pf_*\mathcal F\to R^pf'_*\mathcal F'$, using exactness of $g^*$ [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-pullback-exact-pushforward-injective]. Define $\beta^\flat$ to be the adjoint of $\beta$; these maps are independent of the resolutions and lifts. Then, under the descriptions of $R^pf_*\mathcal F$ and $R^pf'_*\mathcal F'$ as sheafified presheaves [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-presheaf], $\beta^\flat$ is the morphism induced by the maps of presheaves $H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)\to H^p(f'^{-1}(g^{-1}(V)),\mathcal F')$, $V\subseteq S$ open, given by the pullback along $g'|:f'^{-1}(g^{-1}(V))=g'^{-1}(f^{-1}(V))\to f^{-1}(V)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] (a) (with $(g'|)^*(\mathcal F|_{f^{-1}V})=\mathcal F'|_{g'^{-1}f^{-1}V}$): for $\xi\in H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)$ with image $[\xi]\in(R^pf_*\mathcal F)(V)$, $\beta^\flat_V([\xi])$ is the image of $(g'|)^*\xi$ in $(R^pf'_*\mathcal F')(g^{-1}(V))$.

proof.text: Take Mathlib injectiveResolution F and injectiveResolution(g′^*F), and obtain an augmented lift by lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-lift. Set beta to the actual flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta of these choices. Pairwise resolution independence proves its equality with the construction for every other valid lift.
For every resolution pair and V use lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices-exist.

For a given I₁,J₁,V,D,xi obtain its own augmented lift t₁ by lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-lift. Apply the fixed-lift section formula. Rewrite its constructed beta to the originally selected beta by pairwise resolution independence. This proves the section formula even for resolutions different from those selecting beta.
